title: Data science project with prompt-engineering report
summary: Postgraduate students complete an individual Python data-analysis project using GenAI and evidence from an industry expert. They submit a project report and a prompt-engineering report documenting prompts, responses, limitations, source provenance, and critical synthesis.

sources.title: A Data Science Course Utilizing GenAI

locator.section: III. Updated Course Design, B. Assessment

sources.evidence_quote: As part of the course assessment, students must create two reports.

assessment.summary: Investigate a business or industry context, conduct Python data analysis, consult an expert and GenAI, and submit linked project and prompt-engineering reports.
student_actions: Use GenAI iteratively to investigate and analyze the selected context.
Document prompts and evaluate advantages and disadvantages of responses.
Synthesize expert, AI, and personal contributions using source color-coding.
Submit both reports and the Python code.

outputs.artifact: Prompt-engineering report with GenAI responses in an appendix

student_role.description: GenAI use is mandatory; students prompt it, compare its output with expert evidence, and critically evaluate each response.

grading.method: Rubric-based joint assessment of corresponding chapters in the two reports.
grading.feedback: Proficiency-scale comments are averaged by chapter and returned as summative feedback.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
